limitations: Published address spans are selected reconstructed resource ranges, not a complete catalog of every game asset.
Resource spans may represent shared resources or collections; they are not distinct in-game object counts.
Address ends are exclusive. Embedded padding positions are not described by this summary.
Resource IDs identify this snapshot and are not stable game IDs.
ROM shares are storage measurements, not gameplay or semantic completion.
Raw assets, code, implementation details and private working material are not distributed.
Pure C selected spans include non-additive linker veneers. Storage accounting is distinct from recovered original functions and gameplay completion.

original_byte_dependency.note: Includes retained original suffixes, code, data, assets and padding; not the number of unknown code bytes.

latest_milestone.title: Battle effect application, resolution and pending reaction
latest_milestone.summary: Application root and eight callbacks, resolution root and pending-reaction root are integrated. All 92 application callback targets now use C; two body/forwarder pairs do not add original functions.
latest_milestone.remaining: Natural battle reachability, full dynamic domains and physical hardware remain unproved.

active_work.title: Local method build and indexing service
active_work.status: Tool implementation and bounded integration validation
active_work.scope: Per-method C/ASM comparison, dependency-bound caches, automatic manifest indexing and bounded parallel requests; no full-ROM disassembly dependency.
